note: season_finish amounts are dollars for the ESPN final-standing champion (1) and runner-up (2) in 2022 and 2023. null means that prize has not been entered yet, so it is left out of earnings. weekly is the regular-season top-scorer prize; a tie splits the amount. 2024 is $50 and 2025–2026 are $75. A later season uses weekly.default.
